title: Company Headquarters at "Thom Son Nuht"
description: Larry remembers his company headquarters, and the hooch he lived in, at a base whose name the family first wrote down from the sound as "Thom Son Nuht". His own spelling is "Ton Son Nuht". The name is read as Tân Sơn Nhứt, the air base beside Saigon; no document has yet placed him there.
researchNotes: 2026-09-14: description updated from "the family transcribes phonetically" to record his own spelling, "Ton Son Nuht" (giscus-stories-c18006791, 2026-08-13; one of the renderings the interview guide marks as carrying his own authority). He has used the name for the base of the hooch, the van and the flight line many times since (e.g. VN-0007, VN-0014, VN-0017 on 2026-09-12). The title keeps the founding brief's rendering, which several records quote. Identification hypothesis and cautions: the place entry (data/places/thom-son-nuht.json) and ledger #3. The unit he served with there is a separate, open question (ledger #2) and is not stated here.
